articles.availability_note: Status follows NASA’s November 19, 2026 update. Perseverance’s radio issues and Odyssey’s reaction-wheel problem are separate. Both retain contact; science is paused. Backup-radio power differs from data rate, and Odyssey’s one–two-month fuel estimate assumes thruster-only orientation while estimates are refined. A wheel moving in one test differs from confirmed recovery. Restart dates are goals. Primary status and network descriptions were inspected; diagnostic logs, fuel measurements and later recovery outcomes were not independently verified.

articles.availability_note: NASA’s November 19, 2026 account describes September–October flowering after a wet austral winter. The possible satellite-era record is a scientist’s qualified assessment. Satellite dates, ground-photo dates and tentative species identifications are distinct. Biodiversity mapping and conservation applications are research aims; lasting ecological recovery and measured management benefits remain unverified. Primary article/captions and instrument background were inspected; underlying imagery, field records and historical papers were not independently reanalysed.
